SECTION 3: 30-YEAR FORENSIC TITLE AUDIT PROTOCOL
================================================================================
Signature Aura enforces a strict 4-pillar forensic statutory verification before listing or recommending any asset:
1. 30-Year Chain of Title Deeds:
   Forensic physical and digital inspection of registered deeds, conveyances, devolution orders, partition deeds, and revenue mutation entries (7/12 extracts, Index II, Property Card) dating back 30+ continuous years at local Sub-Registrar registries.
2. Statutory MahaRERA Compliance Audit:
   Cross-checking promoter land title disclosures, architectural layout approvals, commencement certificates (CC), encumbrance certificates, and active litigations on the official MahaRERA portal.
3. Advocate Title Search Report:
   A formal Title Certificate is issued by High-Court practicing real estate advocates before earnest deposit or agreement execution.
4. Escrow Banking & Non-Disclosure:
   Standard institutional non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) protect client net-worth and identities. Escrow mechanisms ensure capital safety.

================================================================================
SECTION 4: GLOBAL NRI ADVISORY & REPATRIATION FRAMEWORK
================================================================================
1. FEMA & RBI Eligibility:
   Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) and Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs) can freely purchase residential and commercial properties in India without prior RBI approval. Agricultural land, plantation property, and farm houses are excluded under FEMA.
2. Financial Channels:
   Funds must be remitted via normal banking channels through NRE (Non-Resident External), NRO (Non-Resident Ordinary), or FCNR (Foreign Currency Non-Resident) accounts.
3. Repatriation of Capital:
   - For properties acquired through foreign exchange / NRE remittances: The principal sale proceeds of up to two residential properties can be fully repatriated.
   - Under the General Permission (Form 15CA/15CB): NRIs can repatriate up to USD 1,000,000 (One Million US Dollars) per financial year out of balances held in their NRO account.
4. Remote Transaction Execution:
   Signature Aura coordinates Power of Attorney (PoA) adjudication with Indian Consulates, digital title searches, and live Matterport 3D walkthroughs for clients based in London, Dubai, Singapore, New York, and San Francisco.

Q2: How does Signature Aura ensure properties are free of legal disputes?
A2: Every transaction undergoes a statutory 30-year forensic title due diligence protocol led by Partner Akshay Bhote, verifying Sub-Registrar registry devolution deeds, mutation records, and MahaRERA approvals before certifying the title report.

Q3: Can NRIs in USA, UK, or Dubai buy properties through Signature Aura remotely?
A3: Yes. Signature Aura's Global NRI Desk (directed by Partner Rama Bhote) provides complete remote facilitation, including consular Power of Attorney (PoA) stamping, NRE/NRO banking structures, FEMA documentation, and Form 15CA/CB repatriation of up to USD 1 Million per fiscal year.

Q4: What are the prevailing stamp duty rates in Maharashtra for residential real estate?
A4: In Maharashtra (Pune and Mumbai), stamp duty is typically 5% to 7% of the agreement value, plus 1% Metro Cess / Local Body Tax (LBT), and 1% registration fees (capped at ₹30,000 for residential sales). Women buyers receive a 1% concession on residential purchase in Maharashtra.

Q5: How can a private site visit be scheduled with Signature Aura?
A5: Clients can book a private chauffeured site visit by contacting the 24/7 advisory concierge at +91 88056 21111 via call or WhatsApp, or using the interactive AI Assistant on https://signatureaura.com. Sunset viewing slots (4:30 PM - 6:00 PM) are prioritized for penthouses.
